From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: For many people, discovering everything Tanzania offers is a dream. Tanzania has it all: thrilling safaris in search of Africa’s Big Five, a climb up Kilimanjaro, or time to unwind on the beautiful beaches of Zanzibar. The good news is that Your Tanzania Trip can put together a custom made itinerary that matches all your wishes.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?
blocks.html: Looking at our most popular itineraries is a good way to get ideas. Most of our clients like to round off their exciting safari with a few relaxing days on one of Zanzibar’s most beautiful beaches. Is that something you would enjoy too?

blocks.orig: Whether you choose one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or prefer to customize your journey, we are here to assist you. Come aboard and get ready to explore Tanzania at your own pace, exactly the way you like it!
blocks.html: We are happy to help, whether you go for one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or would rather adapt the journey to your own plans. Join us and get ready to discover Tanzania at your own pace, just the way you want!

blocks.orig: Welcome to Tanzania! Upon your arrival at Dar es Salaam Airport, our friendly and knowledgeable guide will be eagerly waiting to warmly welcome you. He will be readily available to assist you and ensure a smooth transfer to your hotel. Sit back, relax, and let us take care of all your travel needs, providing you with a memorable and unforgettable experience in Tanzania.
blocks.html: Welcome to Tanzania! When you land at Dar es Salaam Airport, our friendly guide, who knows the country well, is looking forward to giving you a warm welcome. He is there to help you and makes sure your transfer to the hotel goes smoothly. Lean back and relax while we look after everything you need during your travels, so your time in Tanzania becomes an experience to remember.

blocks.orig: Mikumi National Park lies at a six-hour drive from Dar Es Salaam and is Tanzania's fourth largest national park. The open horizons and abundant wildlife draw frequent comparisons to the more famous Serengeti plains, but its location close to Tanzania's largest city makes Mikumi easier accessible. The park has a great variety of animals: elephants, buffalos, zebras and giraffes are relatively easy to spot, as well as lions mating and many hippos in the resident hippo pool!
blocks.html: A six-hour drive from Dar Es Salaam brings you to Mikumi National Park, the fourth largest national park in Tanzania. Its wide horizons and plentiful wildlife are often compared with the better-known Serengeti plains, yet because it is near Tanzania's largest city, Mikumi is easier to reach. You will see a wide range of animals: elephants, buffalos, zebras and giraffes are fairly easy to find, and so are mating lions and the many hippos in the park's own hippo pool!

blocks.orig: Udzungwa Mountains National Park is a relatively small, mountainous national park, known for its rare endemic species. In this tropical rainforest, you encounter bush elephants, monkeys, several smaller mammals, and over 400 bird species. Animals that can only be found here are primates such as the red Iringa Colobus and the Sanje Crested Mangabey. But also the grey-faced sengi (an elephant shrew) is endemic to Udzungwa as are several remarkable bird species.
blocks.html: Udzungwa Mountains National Park is fairly small and mountainous, and it is famous for rare endemic species. This tropical rainforest is home to bush elephants, monkeys, a number of smaller mammals and more than 400 bird species. Some primates live nowhere else, such as the red Iringa Colobus and the Sanje Crested Mangabey. The grey-faced sengi (an elephant shrew) is also endemic to Udzungwa, and so are a number of notable bird species.

blocks.orig: There are no paved roads in this national park, which means it’s perfect for shorter and longer hikes. The four-hour hike to the Sanje waterfalls is both challenging and refreshing, as you hike up the mountain but can reward yourself with a plunge at the bottom of the waterfall. Along the way, you might just spot one of those rare monkeys in the trees or see elephant tracks (of so-called mountain elephants). Keep in mind that it can be hot during midday, but if you stay in the shade and hydrated, this is a great walk!
blocks.html: With no paved roads inside the park, it is ideal for both short and long hikes. The four-hour walk to the Sanje waterfalls is tough as well as refreshing: you climb the mountain, and at the foot of the waterfall you can treat yourself to a swim. On the way you may see one of those rare monkeys in the trees, or come across elephant tracks (left by the so-called mountain elephants). Bear in mind that midday can be hot, but if you keep to the shade and drink enough, it is a lovely walk!

blocks.orig: Ruaha National Park is the third largest national park in Tanzania. It lies along the Great Ruaha River, is known for its large elephant population, and is a true paradise for birdwatchers with over 570 species. Besides, you might catch a glimpse of lions, leopards, giraffes, zebras, crocodiles, elands, sable antelopes, jackals, or the rare African wild dog. Game drives are special, as you drive through an untouched ecosystem in this relatively quiet but stunning park!
blocks.html: As Tanzania's third largest national park, Ruaha National Park stretches along the Great Ruaha River. It is famous for its big elephant population, and with more than 570 species it is a real paradise for birdwatchers. You may also spot lions, leopards, giraffes, zebras, crocodiles, elands, sable antelopes, jackals or the rare African wild dog. Game drives here feel special, because this fairly quiet yet beautiful park takes you through an untouched ecosystem!

blocks.orig: Fly to Nyerere National Park and experience the breathtaking beauty of Tanzania's diverse wildlife and landscapes. Explore the vast plains, dense forests, and meandering rivers on exhilarating wildlife safaris, discover the iconic "Big Five," and witness the impressive wildebeest migration. Embark on this safari adventure and create unforgettable memories amidst the untamed wilderness of Nyerere National Park.
blocks.html: Take a flight to Nyerere National Park and take in the stunning variety of Tanzania's wildlife and scenery. On exciting wildlife safaris you explore wide plains, thick forests and winding rivers, look for the well-known "Big Five" and see the remarkable wildebeest migration. Set out on this safari and collect memories you will not forget in the wild nature of Nyerere National Park.

blocks.orig: During a boat safari of 2 - 3 hours, you discover the scenic Rufiji River and its animals. From the boat, you might spot hippos, crocodiles, monkeys, many birds AND a beautiful sunset! For this sunset, you set foot on one of the small sandbanks on the river, where you can stretch your legs or enjoy a drink while the sun sets in this magical environment. There is nothing more beautiful than the serenity of a river completely surrounded by nature at this golden hour of the day.
blocks.html: On a boat safari lasting 2 - 3 hours, you explore the beautiful Rufiji River and the animals along it. You may see hippos, crocodiles, monkeys and many birds from the boat, AND a lovely sunset! To watch it, you step onto one of the little sandbanks in the river, where you can stretch your legs or have a drink as the sun goes down in this magical setting. Few things are as beautiful as the calm of a river surrounded entirely by nature during this golden hour of the day.

blocks.orig: Today you discover the jungle, savannah and river sides of the vast Nyerere National Park (previously the Selous Game Reserve) - an amazing place for game drives. This park in southern Tanzania has fewer visitors than the northern parks but boasts elephants, hippos, crocodiles, lions, leopards, giraffes, the endangered rhino, the rare African wild dog and more. It's the second largest park in the country after Serengeti National Park, so be prepared to cover some miles!
blocks.html: Today you explore the jungle, the savannah and the riverbanks of the huge Nyerere National Park (formerly the Selous Game Reserve), a wonderful setting for game drives. This southern Tanzanian park receives fewer visitors than the parks in the north, yet it is home to elephants, hippos, crocodiles, lions, leopards, giraffes, the endangered rhino, the rare African wild dog and other animals. After Serengeti National Park it is the second largest park in the country, so expect to cover quite a few miles!

blocks.orig: This is your last day! Today you fly to Julius Nyerere International Airport in Dar Es Salaam, from where you will catch your international flight home. Having second thoughts? Then don't hesitate to extend your holiday to one of Tanzania's paradise islands such as Zanzibar, Pemba, or Mafia!
blocks.html: Your final day has arrived! Today you take a flight to Julius Nyerere International Airport in Dar Es Salaam, where you board your international flight home. Not ready to leave yet? Feel free to add a stay on one of Tanzania's paradise islands such as Zanzibar, Pemba or Mafia to your holiday!
